verdict.rationale: JumpCloud docs confirm broad MFA method support including hardware keys, biometrics, certificates, and phishing-resistant passwordless login via JumpCloud Go, plus conditional access policies that revoke access based on device/network trust (jumpcloud-docs-6, jumpcloud-docs-16, jumpcloud-docs-2, jumpcloud-docs-7). However, there is no explicit mention of 'FIDO2' or 'passkeys' by name, nor documentation showing an admin can require a specific MFA method (e.g., hardware key only) as a policy scoped to particular sensitive apps — conditional access appears device/network-based rather than method-based. Missing for 10: explicit FIDO2/passkey terminology, per-app MFA-method enforcement policy documentation, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this granular policy control.
